assignment_rule: Attach a source case to a realization only when every dependency item is in that realization; use the same case IDs across its conditions/orders. Keep attached source-conflict cases unavailable.
dependence_note: Cases sharing dependency edits are correlated; expected_case_counts computes a design mean, not variance or an IID confidence interval.
expected_count_formula: E[C_r] = sum_c product_s comb(q_rs,k_cs)/comb(N_s,k_cs), for admitted fixed stratum quotas and a unique-subject item population; E[paraphrases_r] = 3 E[C_r].

exclusions_frozen_v4.count_interpretation: Candidate graph ceiling only; dependency membership within an eventual realization can only reduce attached cases.
exclusions_frozen_v4.reason: Full three-realization role demand exceeds distinct-subject capacity; representative fact per subject and stratum quotas are not admitted.
